name: 西方秧雞

similarSpecies.distinction: Adult Eastern Water Rail R.indicus: dark lores/eye stripe with dull grey supercilium, extensive white throat and brown wash grey breast/upper belly, black-white barred flank/lower belly and barred white undertail; red bill base/lower mandible dark culmen tip. Breeds N Mongolia/E Siberia/NE China/Sakhalin/N Japan winters NE India/Bangladesh/Myanmar/NThailand/NLaos/ESEChina/Korea/SJapan. LC decreasing.

Adult Slaty-breasted Rail Lewinia striata rusty chestnut crown/nape and irregular white/black crossbars upperparts vs black-centred streaks of Rallus; shorter deeper bill pink base/dark culmen, grey underparts pale throat. Juvenile/immature differs. LC increasing globally despite local HK decline.

rangeMap.note: Adult representative.25–28cm rail with long fine slightly decurved red bill darker culmen/tip, dull red pink legs; no or vestigial dark eye stripe, less extensive white throat and darker grey underparts lacking brown tinge vs R.indicus. Few/no indistinct undertail bars researched but artificial artwork undertail not reliable, do not label that as demonstrated diagnostic. Europe/N Africa through W/CAsia to NW China, breeding Xinjiang, north populations winter N Africa/SW/SAsia. korejewi eastern range presumed HK form not assigned to art. HK accidental. LC decreasing. World partial native-country overview, not complete range or precise occurrence/season polygons.
